Sandbox_ZLRC_enableMod_tooltip: Master switch for every fix in this patch.
Sandbox_ZLRC_debug_tooltip: Prints [ZLRC] lines to the console log. Turn on when reporting a problem.
Sandbox_ZLRC_stripGuard: Non-hostile A-Life NPCs do not trigger ZomboDesire/ZomboLust catch + strip
Sandbox_ZLRC_stripGuard_tooltip: Bumping into, running into or stepping on an A-Life NPC that is not hostile to you no longer fires the zombie catch / clothing-strip logic.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcIgnoreSubdued: A-Life NPCs ignore subdued zombies and NPCs
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcIgnoreSubdued_tooltip: A-Life NPCs will not target, shoot or kill anything subdued with ZomboRut, and Jeem residents will not sweep or carry it away.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcIgnoreDragged: Jeem residents ignore corpses you are dragging
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcIgnoreDragged_tooltip: Residents will not try to pick up or move a corpse while a player is dragging it (or it is a ZomboRut scene husk).
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcSexEnabled: Friendly A-Life NPCs appear in ZomboRut's "Ask for Sex" menu
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcSexEnabled_tooltip: Adds the positions ZomboRut has for your gender pair (friendly/allied NPCs only) to ZomboRut Options > ZR: Ask for Sex. F+M: Doggy, Cowgirl, Spooning, Holding, Footjob, Missionary...; M+F and F+F: whatever ZomboRut ships. M+M has no scenes.
Sandbox_ZLRC_persistCaptives: Keep subdued A-Life NPCs subdued after leaving and returning to the area
Sandbox_ZLRC_persistCaptives_tooltip: Stores the captive state on the NPC's A-Life record and re-applies it when the NPC is spawned back in. Also stops downed captives from bleeding out.
Sandbox_ZLRC_showBik: Load the ZomboLust video clip during ZomboRut scenes
Sandbox_ZLRC_showBik_tooltip: The clip is loaded into ZomboLust's viewer window but the window is NEVER opened automatically. Open it yourself with the ZomboLust sidebar button; it shows the clip currently playing.
Sandbox_ZLRC_excitationSource_tooltip: Which nearby bodies raise ZomboLust excitation (pheromones). 'Zombies' means real zombies; 'NPCs' means A-Life NPCs.
Sandbox_ZLRC_cleanEnabled: Allow rinsing subdued NPCs / zombies / corpses
Sandbox_ZLRC_cleanEnabled_tooltip: Adds a right-click 'Rinse off' option when you carry a container with water.
Sandbox_ZLRC_noCloakAfterNpc: No zombie-stench cloak after NPC scenes or with washed bodies
Sandbox_ZLRC_noCloakAfterNpc_tooltip: ZomboRut's stench cloak (zombie scent moodle) is not granted after a scene with an A-Life NPC or with a body you have washed.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcSexMoreScenes: Show the 'More...' sub-menu (blowjob, face sit, reverse lotus ...)
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcSexMoreScenes_tooltip: These are ZomboRut 'defeat'-kind scenes; launched this way ZomboRut plays them as plain consensual sex.
